run_batch_export_scannet: run the script to batch export ScanNet scenes with vertices and labels to numpy files
run_export_one_scan: run export_one_scan to process a single ScanNet scan into vertices and bounding box numpy files
run_batch_load_scannet_data_cli: run the CLI with --max_num_point and --output_folder args to process train and test ScanNet data
refactor_export_one_scan: refactor export_one_scan to filter bounding boxes by OBJ_CLASS_IDS instead of saving all instances
summarize_batch_export: summarize the batch_export function that iterates over scan names and calls export_one_scan for each
